column1: # AQL Language Specification: the aql:parse module (custom parsers)
# Format: input<TAB>expected<TAB>description
# aql:parse lets an AQL author DEFINE a parser and register it as a `parse`
# kind (aql:parselang). A grammar is built from an ABNF source (Parse.abnf),
# declarative rules (Parse.rule, shaped by the Parse.RuleSpec / Parse.AltSpec
# Map subtypes), fixed tokens (Parse.token) and custom lex matchers
# (Parse.matcher); semantic actions (Parse.action) attach AQL fns to grammar
# marks so the parser can emit custom data. Parse.grammar mints the builder;
# Parse.register finalizes it. The carrier is a shared pointer threaded
# through each word and bound to a def. Register-only: run via `parse <name>`.
# §1  ABNF grammar + a mark action — the action's AQL value is the result

aql:parse import end  "aql:parselang" import end  def g Parse.grammar  Parse.action g '@op:o:INC' ([nd:Any] => [7])  Parse.abnf g 'op = "inc" / "dec"' {start:'op'}  Parse.register op g  end  parse op 'inc'
column3: Parse.grammar + Parse.action + Parse.abnf + Parse.register: action value is the AST

column1: aql:parse import end  "aql:parselang" import end  def g Parse.grammar  Parse.action g '@op:o:INC' ([nd:Any] => [{k:'inc'}])  Parse.abnf g 'op = "inc" / "dec"' {start:'op'}  Parse.register opm g  end  (parse opm 'inc').k
column3: an action can build a custom Map node that survives to the parse result

column1: # §2  tokens, a declining matcher, and a declarative rule coexist with ABNF

aql:parse import end  "aql:parselang" import end  def g Parse.grammar  Parse.token g '#PL' '+'  Parse.matcher g skip 1000000 ([s:String] => [None])  Parse.rule g extra {open:[{s:'#PL'}]}  Parse.action g '@op:o:INC' ([nd:Any] => [5])  Parse.abnf g 'op = "inc"' {start:'op'}  Parse.register op2 g  end  parse op2 'inc'
column3: Parse.token, a declining Parse.matcher and a declarative Parse.rule build alongside the ABNF grammar

column1: # §3  the grammar-as-Map-subtypes type exports
aql:parse import end  "aql:parselang" import end  typeof Parse.AltSpec
column3: Parse.AltSpec is a Map subtype describing one grammar alternate

column1: aql:parse import end  "aql:parselang" import end  typeof Parse.RuleSpec
column3: Parse.RuleSpec is a Map subtype describing a rule's open/close alternates

column1: # §4  loud failures (negative coverage)
aql:parse import end  "aql:parselang" import end  def g Parse.grammar  Parse.abnf g '= = bad ='  Parse.register broke g
column3: a malformed ABNF grammar is a loud error at register, not a panic

column1: aql:parse import end  "aql:parselang" import end  def g Parse.grammar  Parse.action g 'noat' ([nd:Any] => [1])
column3: an action ref must start with '@' (a mark/phase selector)

column1: aql:parse import end  "aql:parselang" import end  def g Parse.grammar  Parse.abnf g 'x = "a"' {start:'x'}  Parse.register json g
column3: registering a name that collides with a built-in parse kind is refused
